test_vector_int: test the pybind11 VectorInt bindings for append, insert, extend, slice assignment, and clear operations
test_vector_buffer: test the pybind11 VectorUChar buffer protocol by constructing from bytearray and using memoryview
test_vector_buffer_numpy: test the pybind11 VectorInt numpy array interop including construction from and conversion to numpy arrays
test_map_string_double: test the pybind11 MapStringDouble and UnorderedMapStringDouble bindings for item access, keys, values, and items views
test_noncopyable_containers: test the pybind11 bindings for non-copyable containers including vector, deque, map, and unordered_map
